maddeler.e:
نختار (form VIII)
# نَخْتَارُ (naḵtāru) /nax.taː.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَارَ (iḵtāra)
# نُخْتَارُ (nuḵtāru) /nux.taː.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَارَ (iḵtāra)
# نَخْتَارَ (naḵtāra) /nax.taː.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَارَ (iḵtāra)
# نُخْتَارَ (nuḵtāra) /nux.taː.ra/: first-person plural non-past
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
